criteria.name: C1_future_horizon_depth_lift
criteria.detail: arf(D=30) - arf(D=1), in-band-tick-weighted mean over green cells

criteria.name: C2_past_window_theta_lift
criteria.detail: arf(summary_10) - arf(summary_1) at D=30, ARM_WIN10, within-tick paired

criteria.name: C3_realised_harm_falls
criteria.detail: hazard CONTACTS per 100 steps, ARM_WIN1 minus ARM_WIN10 (contact only -- 'hazard_approach' is proximity-without-contact and its per-episode rate rewards dying sooner). NOT load-bearing: it runs through score-to-committed-action conversion, a separately tracked un-lifted ceiling (f_dominance_conversion_ceiling).

combination_rule: PASS = C1 AND C2 AND non_degenerate. evidence_direction: supports = C1 AND C2 AND C3; mixed = (C1 AND C2 AND NOT C3) or exactly one of C1/C2; weakens = NOT C1 AND NOT C2. C3 is measured and reported but never gates the outcome.
degeneracy_reason: PARTIAL non-vacuity: arm 'ARM_WIN10_s0' failed theta_summary_divergence; arm 'ARM_WIN10_s1' failed theta_summary_divergence; arm 'ARM_WIN10_s2' failed theta_summary_divergence. Arm(s) ARM_WIN1_s0, ARM_WIN1_s1, ARM_WIN1_s2 passed the gate in full and ARE scored -- a red arm does NOT vacate a green one (failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-785_2026-07-19.md sections 2a/8). Read the red arm(s) as unscored, NOT as a refutation.

per_arm_gate.preconditions_scope_note: interpretation.preconditions carries the GREEN arm(s) only (ARM_WIN1_s0, ARM_WIN1_s1, ARM_WIN1_s2). The RED arm(s) (ARM_WIN10_s0, ARM_WIN10_s1, ARM_WIN10_s2) are carried in full at top level under per_arm_gate.red, and their criteria are marked load_bearing:false + criteria_non_degenerate:false. The indexer's _compute_adjudication reads interpretation.preconditions FLAT and ARM-BLIND and returns precondition_unmet for the WHOLE RUN on the first unmet entry, so including a scored-out arm's failure here would re-vacate the green arm at adjudication time.

preconditions.name: ARM_WIN1_s0::approach_recede_gap

notes: arf is read off the PRE-SAMPLING E3 harm term, never the sampled action, so this probe is commitment-free.
